reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped six-domain review of native FPCA statistical scientific-artist geometry only. Source Matplotlib arrays are compared in committed pinned Python 1.2 tests, and genuine native bootstrap estimators are exercised. Exact-head Python/three-OS CI is not observed green; no independently certified source-contract or Python matplotlib runtime return parity is claimed.
native_language_semantic_policy: Scientific arrays, confidence limits, score references, source errorbar parameters, fill band alpha and legend/titles are source comparable on accepted native fit-result classes. Native R base graphics returns typed R source scientific data rather than Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure, pixel output or Python-specific error exceptions.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_fpca_score_uncertainty, matched by optional native strict scientific artist data.

Supported native result is actual fixed-target matched-bootstrap FPCA score uncertainty with complete original target IDs, reference-score matrix and finite median/lower/upper percentile matrices. The component index is zero-based as in Python, max_targets a positive non-Boolean integer, and the source plot is limited to the first n targets. Native R cannot accept Python ax injection or return Python Figure/Axes runtime objects.

The source errorbar artist is located at exact x=0..n-1 with median, asymmetric yerr=[median-lower,upper-median], marker='o', linestyle='none', capsize=3. The fixed full-sample reference-score scatter is marker='x', and y=0 reference, original ordered target labels rotated 90°, source legend and title are preserved. Committed direct public frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib get_xdata/get_ydata, actual scatter get_offsets and legend/axis comparisons on the same fixed-target source bootstrap arrays. Also tests actual independently generated native 20-replicate FPCA score bootstrap; exact-head green CI not yet witnessed.

Strict rejects nonlogical opt-in mode, wrong native source class, out-of-range zero-based index, nonpositive/noninteger max_targets, mismatched target/reference array dimensions, nonfinite scores or interval inversions. Python TypeError/IndexError and external Axes mutation are not replicated by native R.

Frozen Python returns one Matplotlib Axes with ErrorbarContainer, scatter PathCollection and horizontal reference line. The native R default still returns the same five-column score data frame, while strict mode draws native R graphics and returns a typed one-panel source scientific artist record with exact coordinates, cap settings, reference scatter, labels, and explicit false Python object identity.

Bootstrap uncertainty in original fixed target FPCA scores induced by re-estimation, matching and sign-aligning the FPCA basis. The plotted percentile envelope does not include measurement error, future trajectory randomness or a different inference estimand.

independent_review_status: Provisional author scoped scientific geometry; zero independent source-contract certifications, successful exact-head differential CI not witnessed.
language_specific_limits: R base plotting returns R graphics state plus source scientific artist data, not live Matplotlib Axes/Figure nor identically rendered pixels.
Supported R classes and numerical domains are restricted to genuine native FPCA bootstrap results; general Python ax injection and runtime object protocol equivalence are not delivered.
Python and R exception classes and implementation-specific random bootstrap PCG64/base-R draws remain distinct.
No independent scientific parity approval, merged main-branch source or CRAN qualification is implied.
